tools.name: cloudflare.setup
tools.description: Write the Cloudflare tunnel, Access, and agent auth unit. Does not print tokens.

tools.name: cloudflare.access
tools.description: Report whether Cloudflare Access is configured. Does not return a token or a JWT.

tools.name: cloudflare.auth
tools.description: Report the shared Access service-token paths, header names, and seat limits.

tools.name: cloudflare.logs
tools.description: Read recent events from the host log Durable Object. Does not return tokens or arguments.

tools.name: cloudflare.admin
tools.description: Report the login-keychain Cloudflare API token state. Does not return the token.

tools.name: cloudflare.apply
tools.description: Call the Cloudflare API with the login-keychain token. The token is not an argument and is not returned.

tools.name: cloudflare.token
tools.description: Ask the user to store the Cloudflare API token in the login keychain. The token is not an argument.

tools.name: cloudflare-token
tools.description: Ask the user to store the Cloudflare API token in the login keychain. The token is not an argument.

tools.name: cloudflare-api
tools.description: Call the Cloudflare API with the login-keychain token. The token is not an argument and is not returned.

tools.name: cloudflare.check
tools.description: Check the cloudflare unit recorded by cloudflare.setup.

tools.name: cloudflare.uninstall
tools.description: Delete the cloudflare folder under the self-hosted home. That folder holds the install, config, and state cloudflare.setup wrote.
